delivery.route: Qin Military Bureau receiving office in Kanyou

event_contact_audience_0da9f54adbced7a4d.summary: The Qin Military Bureau receiving office makes a duty officer available to hear Tang Wei regarding the northern Wei operation. This establishes a hearing only: Tang Wei has not yet made a substantive request, and Qin has made no appointment, command, deployment decision, or commitment.

event_family_counsel_response_14f8deacee.basis_goal: Tang Ling responds to Tang Wei's request for counsel
event_family_counsel_response_14f8deacee.summary: Tang Ling advises separating preparation from commitment: verify which Qin authority owns the matter and what formal request, if any, actually reaches House Tang before spending new House silver or binding House forces. In the meantime she recommends preserving the House's existing obligations and gathering firmer political and logistical information rather than treating preparations as a settled campaign result.

event_family_counsel_response_d5988c969b.basis_goal: Tang Zhu responds to Tang Wei's request for counsel
event_family_counsel_response_d5988c969b.summary: Tang Zhu advises preparing without pretending preparation is deployment: keep House military readiness in hand, clarify command, route, supply, timing, and the strength Qin actually requires, and do not march House forces into a state campaign merely because reports say an operation is forming. He recommends acting once a lawful command or a deliberate House decision gives the effort a concrete objective.

event_household_response_769c2d0b8dd70ce.summary: House Tang opens Great Bow Guard applicant intake under a treasury-safe ceiling of 4370400 silver. Opening the intake creates no fighter headcount and commits no spending; standards remain unchanged. Sword Manor has no trainee vacancy at this review (5000 of 5000 trainee places occupied), so no new Initiates can be added now. Existing Initiates continue training.

event_household_response_fe299524f7735dc.summary: Tang Zhu identifies the current practical constraints on parallel recruiting: Great Bow Guard remains an applicant intake only; screening, accepted headcount, equipment and formation creation have not yet settled; Sword Manor has no trainee vacancy. The two programs remain institutionally separate, so one does not consume the other's authorized fighting establishment.

event_ouki_preliminary_review_dispositio.summary: Ouki's staff records Tang Wei's preliminary command-qualification review as completed. The completed review remains evidence for future staff consideration, but this disposition creates no current field-command vacancy, Qin appointment, private-unit acceptance, or deployment authority.

event_ouki_preliminary_review_evaluation.summary: Ouki's staff-review channel completes internal collation of Tang Wei's preliminary command-qualification review and sends word that its staff disposition is ready through the same registered channel. event_ouki_preliminary_review_response_0.summary: Ouki's staff-review channel acknowledges Tang Wei's presentation in Kanyou and returns word that his preliminary command-qualification review can proceed.
